exposure: Pre-rupture of membranes prior labour initiation
limited and inadequate health literacy towards pre-rupture of membranes
cohort: 210 lactating mothers within 6 weeks following delivery at Thulamela B clinics of Vhembe district
finding: Limited health literacy regarding pre-rupture of membranes contributed to perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: This study mentions mode of delivery but does not examine outcomes related to it.
